code_label: MPS for time-series state preparation

code_label: Path-dependent pricing needs joint path distributions
text_span: we need to generate a quantum state that encodes the joint distribution of the asset price at the different time points
rationale: Motivates the technical problem the paper addresses.

code_label: Existing state-preparation methods are costly

code_label: No prior time-series generative modeling for option pricing
text_span: there is no previous study on preparing a state encoding the time series distribution via generative modeling in the context of option pricing on a quantum computer
rationale: Claims novelty relative to prior work.

code_label: MPS is classically tractable and quantum-circuit compatible

code_label: Heston model used as validation target

code_label: MPS can generate Heston paths for pricing
text_span: the MPS model can successfully generate the price paths of the Heston model and be used in pricing these options
rationale: Summarizes the paper’s claimed empirical outcome.

code_label: Option payoffs defined for path dependence
text_span: our study focuses on path-dependent options, whose payoff depends not on the asset price at a single time point but on the values at multiple time points or the entire path of the asset price
rationale: Defines the class of financial products targeted by the method.
